::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 15 1895  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book, Hampshire Record Office 70M92W/59/232
:::

My dear [Madam](people/person_1604.qmd)
I sent you the Policy on Saturday & I hope by this time you have received it  The Policy now is transferred to Miss Yonge she being entitled to it having paid the £1000 & I believe all the interest & premiums, however as she wished me to send it to you I did so.  I understood from Miss Yonge that she had certain intentions with regard to the Policy, but of course I am not at liberty to mention them without her consent

I am yours faithy
[Chas Wooldridge](people/person_2094.qmd)

Mrs. Yonge
